summary: Multi-start SLSQP on (x, y, r) with analytic Jacobians, using random starts and basin-hopping perturbations of the best layout. Each candidate's radii are re-solved exactly by an LP for fixed centres, so the final packing is feasible.

Multi-start SLSQP on (x, y, r) with analytic Jacobians, using random and hex-like starts, then perturbation of the best solution. Each result is polished by an exact LP for the radii given the centres, so the final packing is feasible.

Multi-start SLSQP on (x, y, r) with analytic Jacobians, maximising the sum of radii. Random starts come first, then basin-hopping perturbations of the best solution. The finish is an LP for exact radii at the final centres, shrunk by a tiny margin to guarantee feasibility.
